periods.time: Immediately after the poltergeist culprit is captured

name.zh: 贵德原彼方阐明贵族义务

periods.location: Hagun Academy after the poltergeist hunt
periods.summary: Kanata uses her family foundation to protect the captured special-individual monkey and explains why preserving the Tokutomiya house is her chivalry.
periods.cause: Special individuals that attack humans are normally destroyed, but the monkey is frightened, injured and not truly malicious.
periods.process: Kanata contacts her family to arrange protection, then tells Ikki about the Tokutomiya family's inherited noblesse oblige and her expected arranged marriage after graduation.
periods.outcome: The monkey is spared; Ikki understands that Kanata willingly prioritizes the family's charitable power over personal romantic freedom.
periods.significance: Defines Kanata's personal knightly creed and reframes her arranged-marriage future as a chosen responsibility rather than mere victimhood.
